carouselSections.title: AN ADRENALINE
carouselSections.subtitle: FUELED ESCAPE!
carouselSections.content: The ultimate ATV experience. Climb Aboard an open-air safari truck for 25 minutes and enjoy a scenic journey through vibrant landscape of Puerto Plata.
displayContent: Transfer to ATV hub: Climb aboard an open-air safari truck for 25 minutes and enjoy a scenic journey through the vibrant landscape of Puerto Plata.
ATV backcountry exploration: After your guide’s safety briefing and driving test, put on your helmet and goggles, and hop into your automatic single or double ATV for an exciting one-hour ride.
Visit the picturesque rural area of Puerto Plata, drive through the lush rainforests, and prepare to get a little wet as you cross shallow creeks.
Coffee & Chocolate break: Get ready for a 15-minute cultural stop at a traditional Dominican country house. Freshly brewed coffee, rich chocolate, and authentic cigar tastings are included.
Photo shooting & break at the beach: Rest for 30 minutes at a local beach, where incredible views of the Atlantic shoreline and mountains beckon you to relax and unwind before heading back to port.
displayIncluded: Round trip transportation on open air safari truck
ATV through rural areas, backcountry private ranch, rainforest and stop at the beach

displayWhatToBring.text: Closed shoes (mandatory, not sandals, or crocs)

displayNote: Physical valid driver’s license and closed shoes are mandatory. The minimum age to participate is 18 years old, and the maximum age is 65 years old. The maximum weight limit is 260 pounds or 117 kilograms. Alcohol will be distributed with careful tolerance to everyone. Guests must be ambulatory. Wheelchairs (collapsible or electric) are not permitted. For safety reasons, expectant mothers, guests with neck or back problems, recent surgeries, or patients with diabetes, epilepsy, blindness, asthma, or any other heart or respiratory conditions are not eligible to participate in this excursion.
Following the tour guide’s and staff’s instructions is mandatory. Guests may face cancellation without the possibility of a refund if they fail to adhere to the rules.
